records.title: Loss in West Bengal due to ganga Erosion
details: A Committee comprising members from the State Government of West Bengal and concerned Central Government Departments, under the chairmanship of chairman, central Water Commission has been constituted by the Department of Water Resources, River Development & ganga Rejuvenation to undertake a joint detailed technical study for an integrated plan to combat the threat of erosion posed by ganga-Padma river in the district of Malda, Murshidabad & Nadai in West Bengal.

records.title: BENEFICIARIES UNDER PM-SVANIDHI SCHEME
details:
Hon''ble Minister inter-alia stated as under:- I can give the figures. What I can tell you, Sir, is: Overall, the percentage of marginalized sections, the OBCs,
is 43 per cent, SCs- 19 per cent, STs – 3 per cent and Other Minorities - 8 per cent. But State-wise, I can get the data. I would be very happy to provide it; but it will need to be collected because we do not collect data on that basis. It is the banks, which give the loans as per the guidelines, which maintain the data. But if you want to know how many in the State of Odisha or how many in Andhra Pradesh, it is something that, I am sure, we can try and get and share with the hon. Member.
